name: Superon Superstain 308L Stainless Steel Welding Electrodes (2.5mm x 350mm)
shortDescription: Extra-low carbon rutile-coated austenitic stainless steel electrodes (AWS E308L-16) designed for smooth, spatter-free welding of 18Cr-8Ni stainless steels like SS 304 and 304L.
overview: Superon 308L is an ultra-pure, rutile-coated austenitic stainless steel electrode engineered for welding 19% Chromium - 9% Nickel steels (AISI 304, 304L, 308). With an extra-low carbon content (C <= 0.04%), it drastically minimizes chromium carbide precipitation at grain boundaries, providing exceptional resistance to intergranular corrosion. The specially formulated flux ensures instant arc restrike, soft arc characteristics, negligible spatter, and self-peeling slag that leaves a mirror-smooth radiographic-quality bead finish on both AC and DC+ polarity.
keyFeatures: AWS A5.4 / ASME SFA 5.4 E308L-16 classification for austenitic stainless steel
Extra-low carbon formulation prevents intergranular carbide precipitation corrosion
Self-releasing slag requiring minimal post-weld grinding or chiseling
Exceptionally smooth arc with low spatter loss on both AC and DC+ currents
Fine-rippled, aesthetically brilliant bead appearance ideal for food & pharmaceutical standards
Controlled ferrite content (FN 4-8) ensures crack resistance during cooling
Vacuum-sealed moisture-resistant packaging ensures zero porosity on critical joints
applications: Dairy, brewery, and food processing plant equipment
Chemical, fertilizer, and petrochemical storage tanks
Architectural stainless steel railings and decorative fabrication
Hospital equipment and kitchen exhaust ductwork
